system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: It receives the parent node’s training configuration, text summaries of step-level metrics, and the best validation score.
system_prompt_style.note: Proposer prompt template (App. I.1, not in evidence) filled with node config and metrics; human-written metric descriptions injected.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: LLM agents analyze training dynamics through textual metrics and visual plots
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the harness injects metric summaries and plots up front, not a file tree; no retrieval or navigation tools. Mismatch with the value list.

context_compaction.note: Fixed workflow, not a long conversation; the paper does not describe history handling.

observation_format.evidence_quote: analyzes training dynamics (rewards, KL divergence, validation scores, gradient norms) through both text summaries and visual plots
observation_format.note: The images are metric plots, not screenshots; screenshots is the closest value.

tool_call_format.note: The early stopper outputs CONTINUE or STOP; the proposer's output format is in App. I, which is not in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: The pipeline generates training code (Sec. 3.6); the editing mechanism is not described.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: LLMZEROperforms a modified MCTS over train-ing trajectories. Each iteration selects a node via UCT, expands it by proposing a hyperparameter transition (or debugging a failure), executes the training phase, and backpropagates the validation score.
loop_primitives.note: The paper also says 'The adaptive strategy search follows a fixed workflow' (Sec. 3.6).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Its reasoning proceeds in four stages: (1)diagnosethe parent run’s train-ing health
planning_granularity.note: The search tree is a stored structure, but it is not a task plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the essential LLM-based components are theproposer agent(§3.4) and the agentic early stopper(§3.5)
multi_agent_topology.note: Two specialised LLM components inside a fixed workflow; closest value is pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The adaptive strategy search fol-lows a fixed workflow

short_term_state.evidence_quote: each node stores a full hyperparameter configuration and resumes from a parent checkpoint

state_persistence.evidence_quote: When an evolve node is created, it loads its par-ent’s model weights at stepk and continues training
state_persistence.note: These are training checkpoints of the target model, not checkpoints of the agent run.

self_verification.evidence_quote: It outputs CONTINUE or STOP with explicit reasoning about whether the current trajectory is likely to surpass the incumbent’s performance
self_verification.note: A separate early-stopper LLM judges each training run; validation score is also backpropagated.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Children are created by resuming from a parent checkpoint with modified hyperparameters (evolving), by fixing failed runs (debugging), or by starting fresh to maintain diver-sity.

rollback.evidence_quote: The policy can backtrack to any earlier checkpoint, enabling branching.

termination_condition.note: Budget B is typically 4–16 iterations. The early stopper terminates dominated runs, which is the closest match to stall_detection.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: under a small budgetB (typically 4– 16 iterations, each requiring hours of GPU time)
cost_controls.note: The budget is an iteration/compute budget, not a token budget.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Infrastructure: Ray clusters on EKS, 32–64 A100 40G GPUs.

eval_hooks.note: Validation scoring is built into the search loop; no repo was available to confirm.
